    A=np.column_stack([tt, PP*np.log(PP), np.sin(a[0]*tt)/PP]+cols)
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,yy,rcond=None)[0]

from scipy.optimize import least_squares
tt=np.asarray(df['t']); PP=np.asarray(df['P']); yy=np.asarray(df['dP_dt'])
TSS=np.sum((yy-yy.mean())**2)
def sse(a, extra):
    cols=[tt, PP*np.log(PP), np.sin(a[0]*tt)/PP]+extra
    A=np.column_stack(cols)
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,yy,rcond=None)[0]
    return np.sum((A@c-yy)**2)/TSS, c
for name,extra in [('t2/P',[tt**2/PP]),('t2/P,t/P',[tt**2/PP,tt/PP]),('t2/P,sin(bt)/P',[tt**2/PP, np.sin(0.5*tt)/PP]), ('t*sin(bt)/P+sin(...)', [tt*np.sin(0.16*tt)/PP])]:
    best=(1,None,None)
    for a0 in np.linspace(0.05,1.0,40):
        s,c=sse([a0],extra)
        if s<best[0]: best=(s,a0,c)
    r=least_squares(lambda a: np.sqrt(sse(a,extra)[0])*np.ones(1),[best[1]])
    s,c=sse(r.x,extra)
    print(name, s, r.x, c)
